dump_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to libpcap dump filenames.

flows.description: List of flow configurations. Each flow defines endpoints and behavior. If empty, defaults to localhost IPv4 test. Index starts at 0 (first flow is flow 0).

flows[].block_size.description: Uniform block size for both endpoints, in bytes. Ignored if stochastic traffic is configured.

flows[].block_size_limit.description: Cap for stochastic block sizes, in bytes. Required for unbounded distributions.

flows[].control_dest.description: Control connection port or address for destination. Same format as control_source.

flows[].control_source.description: Control connection port or address for source. If omitted, default port is used. Optional; if present, format is ':PORT' or 'HOST:PORT'.

flows[].duration_dest.description: Flow duration for destination endpoint, in seconds. 0 = unlimited.

flows[].duration_source.description: Flow duration for source endpoint, in seconds.

flows[].gap_distribution.description: Distribution type for interpacket gap (seconds). Same options.

flows[].host_dest.description: Destination endpoint hostname or IP (IPv4 or IPv6).

flows[].host_source.description: Source endpoint hostname or IP (IPv4 or IPv6).

flows[].min_response_size.description: If true, use minimal response size for RTT calculation (same as -A b).

flows[].pushy.description: If true, disable select() iteration (pushy sending).

flows[].request_distribution.description: Distribution type for request size (stochastic traffic). One of: C, U, E, N, L, P, W.

flows[].request_params.description: Distribution parameters for request size. For C: [value]; for U: [min, max]; for N/E: [mean/variance]; for L/P/W: [zeta/kappa, sigma/k].

flows[].response_distribution.description: Distribution type for response size. Same options as request_distribution.

flows[].response_params.description: Distribution parameters for response size. Same semantics as request_params.

flows[].socket_opts.description: List of socket option strings (e.g., ['TCP_NODELAY']). Applies to both endpoints.

flows[].tcp_congestion.description: TCP congestion control algorithm (e.g., 'cubic', 'reno'). If empty, use system default.

flows[].tcp_cork.description: If true, set TCP_CORK on socket.

flows[].tcp_info_metrics.description: List of TCP_INFO metrics to display beyond defaults. Allowed: 'interval', 'through', 'transac', 'iat', 'kernel', 'blocks', 'rtt', 'delay'.

log_file.description: Path to logfile. If empty, use default 'flowgrind-<timestamp>.log'. If non-empty, enable logging to file.

one_way_delay.description: If true, compute one-way delay (requires no clock sync).

overwrite_log.description: If true, overwrite existing log files. If false, append or fail.

random_seed.description: Random seed for reproducible stochastic traffic. -1 means use /dev/urandom.

report_interval.description: Reporting interval in seconds. Controls interval between intermediate reports.

show_columns.description: List of column types to show in output beyond the default ones. Allowed: 'interval', 'through', 'transac', 'iat', 'kernel', 'blocks', 'rtt', 'delay'.

tcp_stack_unit.description: Force unit for TCP stack metrics: 'segment' or 'byte'. If empty, auto-detect.

throughput_unit.description: If true, report throughput in MiB/s (2^20 bytes/s); else default Mbit/s (10^6 bit/s).
